original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')

from telos import aos_manager

TICK_TO_LOG = 91

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="modify_code",
    target="aos_manager.py",
    metadata={"purpose": "Standardize logging function signature"}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="update_meta",
    target="meta_prompt",
    metadata={"new_objective": "Integrate analyzer"}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="admin_aos",
    target="task_list",
    metadata={"eval_id": 216, "completed": 22, "activated": 23}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="create_code",
    target="agency_analyzer.py",
    metadata={"purpose": "Initial copy for integration"}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="log_actions",
    target="tick_90",
    metadata={"eval_id": 217}
)

print("Structured logging complete.")
